releaseNotes: Account and playlist fixes: switching playlists can no longer show the previous account's catalog or expiry date; a connection hiccup during a background refresh can no longer blank your folder list; M3U playlists now sign in automatically on launch; Continue Watching items from before the server change now play again and keep your place; editing a saved playlist no longer switches you onto it or renames it; deleting the playlist in use now asks you to switch first. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
